subject: literacy
concept: Reading a full short decodable story combining all P1 phonics skills learned so far
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading decodable-text sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while reading a short multi-sentence decodable story
exercise.abstract: Student reads a full short decodable story aloud with reasonable fluency and answers comprehension questions about it

assessment.mastery_threshold: reads with 90%+ accuracy and answers 3 of 4 comprehension questions correctly
misconception_flags: decodes accurately but cannot recall or answer questions about the story's content

interest_binding: story generated fresh from student's stated interest profile, using only decodable vocabulary learned so far
